features.definition: Dominant body color is blue or blue-gray (0=not blue, 1=clearly blue dominant)
Dominant body color is green (0=not green, 1=clearly green dominant)
Dominant body color is brown or tan (0=not brown/tan, 1=clearly brown/tan dominant)
Dominant body color is red or dark red (0=not red, 1=clearly red dominant)
Pokémon stands/walks primarily on two legs in upright or semi-upright posture (1=yes, 0=no)
Pokémon is primarily four-legged or moves on four limbs (1=yes, 0=no)
Body is primarily snake-like or elongated without prominent limbs (1=yes, 0=no)
Pokémon resembles a bird with wings and beak (1=yes, 0=no)
Pokémon resembles an insect or arthropod (many legs, exoskeleton, antennae etc.) (1=yes, 0=no)
Pokémon has an undefined, blob-like, or ghostly body shape without clear limbs (1=yes, 0=no)
Pokémon has visible plant-like features (leaves, vines, flowers, bark etc.) (0=none, 1=heavily plant-like)
Pokémon appears water/aquatic themed (fins, water droplets, aquatic body shape) (0=none, 1=strongly aquatic)
Pokémon has visible fire or flame-like elements on its body (0=none, 1=prominently fiery)
Pokémon has metallic, mechanical, or armor-like appearance (0=none, 1=heavily metallic)
Pokémon resembles a dragon (scales, claws, wings optional, reptilian fierce appearance) (0=not dragon-like, 1=strongly dragon-like)
Pokémon has a clearly visible tail (1=yes, 0=no)
Pokémon has wings or wing-like appendages (1=yes, 0=no)
Pokémon has horns, antennae, or horn-like protrusions on head (1=yes, 0=no)
Pokémon's face/pose looks aggressive, angry, or menacing (0=calm/cute, 1=very aggressive)
Pokémon appears cute, friendly, or approachable in expression (0=not cute, 1=very cute/friendly)
Pokémon appears large/bulky relative to typical Pokémon (0=small/tiny, 1=very large/bulky)
Image shows more than one distinct creature entity (1=yes multiple, 0=single entity)
Pokémon body has notable spots, circular patterns, or decorative markings (1=yes, 0=no)
Pokémon incorporates cloud, smoke, or gas elements visually (1=yes, 0=no)
Pokémon has a humanoid silhouette (upright, two arms, two legs, recognizable torso/head) (0=not humanoid, 1=strongly humanoid)

Pokémon is clearly based on a real-world animal (mammal, bird, reptile, fish, etc.) with recognizable animal body structure (0=not based on a real animal or highly abstract, 1=clearly resembles a specific real animal)
Pokémon has clearly defined, separate limbs (arms and/or legs) as distinct appendages from the body (0=no distinct limbs or limbs indistinct/merged, 1=clearly has distinct arms and/or legs)

notes: The user seems to be grouping by body type/posture: upright bipeds and humanoid-shaped Pokémon (including animal bipeds) are grouped together, separate from quadrupeds, serpentines, amorphous/blob types, and strongly non-animal forms. item_033 (ferret quadruped) should join the biped/upright group, suggesting the criterion may be more about 'animal-like with limbs and upright tendency' vs 'non-humanoid/non-biped'. The key separators are: biped/humanoid vs quadruped/serpentine/amorphous, and NOT color. Need to heavily boost is_biped, humanoid_shape, and penalize is_amorphous, is_serpentine, is_quadruped, blue_dominant.
